nodes.label: LabSpark AI
nodes.rationale: AI-first virtual science lab for NCERT Class 6-10, differentiated from static Indian virtual labs (OLabs/DIKSHA) by a live conversational AI tutor inside true 3D experiments rather than passive simulations.

nodes.label: Spark (AI Tutor)
nodes.rationale: A Socratic conversational co-teacher (voice + text) is the category-shift from passive simulation to active AI-tutored practice; it is the core differentiator no India-focused competitor holds.

nodes.label: Google Gemini
nodes.rationale: Gemini 2.5 Flash (text) chosen for sub-second latency and low token cost; live native-audio model powers premium two-way voice. Gemini 2.0-flash is not available to this account.

nodes.label: Cloud Run Backend (server/index.js)
nodes.rationale: Express backend on Cloud Run holds the Gemini key server-side so it is never shipped to the browser; exposes /api/spark/ask, /api/spark/react, /api/grade and WS /api/live.

nodes.label: Firebase (Auth/Firestore/Hosting)
nodes.rationale: Firebase Auth + Firestore hold student progress; Firestore rules let each signed-in student read/write only their own users/{uid} document; Hosting/CDN serves the static Vite build.

nodes.label: React Three Fiber WebGL 3D Labs
nodes.rationale: Procedural WebGL models mean no licensed 3D assets to buy or host; the whole lab is code, making it self-contained and instantly updatable.

nodes.label: Data-Driven 3D Lab Engine (genlab3d)
nodes.rationale: The scalability lever: a new lab is one spec object in genlabdata.js (shape, color, category, mode) rendered automatically in the shared 3D room -- no new engineering per lab.

nodes.label: GEN_LABS Lab Specifications (genlabdata.js)
nodes.rationale: GEN_LABS is the lab content as pure data; adding a lab means writing a spec plus a matching CATALOG entry, which app.jsx auto-routes to GenLab3D.

nodes.label: Cost Optimisation Model
nodes.rationale: Early prototype cost ~Rs.25/session on always-on live voice (unviable). Re-engineered: narration free (browser TTS + cached clips), AI on-demand only for novel questions + one grading call, common questions from local cache, live voice opt-in premium -> a standard lab now costs well under Rs.1, a core competitive moat for Indian price points.

nodes.label: Auth + Rate-Limit Security Model
nodes.rationale: Every /api/* call requires a Firebase ID token; per-user rate limits (20/min, 300/day) and CORS locked to app domains prevent quota/cost abuse. Gemini key stays server-side only.

nodes.label: Monetization Engine (B2C + B2B SaaS)
nodes.rationale: Dual model: B2C freemium credits + Spark Pass subscription via Stripe/Razorpay, and B2B school licensing at $1/student/month, targeting >=80% gross margin to satisfy the XPRIZE commercial-viability requirement. Currently billing UI is mock display only.

nodes.label: CBSE Practical File PDF (practicalfile.js)
nodes.rationale: Client-side jsPDF generator building a CBSE-format Science Practical File from GEN_LABS specs plus the student's per-item verdicts, at Rs.0 marginal cost -- the paperwork-removal deliverable that makes schools pay.

nodes.label: Classroom / Teacher Layer (classroom.js)
nodes.rationale: The B2B wedge: classes/{CODE} with denormalised teacherUid on members/submissions so security rules authorise reads without a get(). Additive and non-breaking to the solo-student flow.

nodes.label: Roles + Family/Relationship Graph
nodes.rationale: Student/Teacher/Parent roles chosen at sign-up route to role-specific homes; Teacher-Student via class code, Parent-Student via family code with a privacy-safe progress mirror (students/{uid}) exposing only XP/level/labs/scores.

nodes.label: Firestore 'Rules Are Not Filters' Principle
nodes.rationale: Teacher reads are authorised by resource.data.teacherUid, so the client query MUST filter .where('teacherUid','==',uid) or the whole query is permission-denied. This was the real 'teacher can't see joined students' bug; every teacher-scoped query and collection must denormalise teacherUid.

nodes.label: Trusted Web Activity (TWA) + Bubblewrap
nodes.rationale: Ship the existing web app as a native Android app via Google's TWA + Bubblewrap so one codebase runs in real Chrome (speechSynthesis, WebGL, getUserMedia, web auth all behave like desktop Chrome), avoiding a native rewrite.

nodes.label: Installable Mobile PWA
nodes.rationale: A responsive, installable PWA (manifest, maskable icons, Workbox service worker) is the hard prerequisite TWA cannot fix for us -- the responsive pass is ~60% of the effort and gates everything; deploys to a separate Firebase Hosting target to keep the live site and main untouched.

nodes.label: Non-Disruption Guarantee
nodes.rationale: All Android/PWA work lives on the android-app branch and deploys to a separate hosting target; the only backend edit is an additive CORS/WS origin allow-list (a superset), so existing web users see zero behaviour change.

nodes.label: Digital Asset Links (assetlinks.json)
nodes.rationale: Serving /.well-known/assetlinks.json with the Play App Signing SHA-256 fingerprint verifies ownership so the TWA URL bar disappears and ?join=CODE deep links open the app.

nodes.label: Socratic Spark (Predict-Observe-Explain)
nodes.rationale: Inserts a predict->observe->explain inquiry loop so students reason like scientists; predict prompt is scripted (Rs.0) and only mispredictions call /api/spark/explain, capping AI cost to ~1-2 calls per lab. Opt-in per lab via an optional socratic{} spec block so all 42 existing labs keep working.

nodes.label: Teacher Live-Class + Marks
nodes.rationale: Assignments -> live run (incl. projector/turn-taking mode for one-device classrooms) -> AI-drafted marks with teacher override (AI proposes, teacher disposes) -> gradebook export. The adoption/revenue axis; the reason a school pays.

nodes.label: Gradebook CSV Export (gradebook.js)
nodes.rationale: One row per student x assigned lab with correct/total, predictionAccuracy, aiMark, teacherMark, approved -- the CSV schools paste into internal-assessment/report-card systems, the deliverable that makes the product 'compliance paperwork removed'.

nodes.label: Design Token System (C object + CSS vars)
nodes.rationale: Styling is not Tailwind: a JS token object C (tokens.js) mirrored by CSS custom properties in index.css. Visual language is 'scientific authority' -- teal primary, indigo AI/Spark accent, JetBrains Mono telemetry labels. Always reference a token, never a raw hex.

nodes.label: Build with Gemini XPRIZE Hackathon
nodes.rationale: The 3-month hackathon target scoped the MVP to Class 6-10 NCERT and demanded provable commercial viability, driving the monetization engine and investor/judge revenue dashboard built into the prototype.

nodes.label: NCERT/CBSE Class 6-10 Curriculum
nodes.rationale: Scope locked to Class 6-10 Physics & Chemistry practicals (150M+ students) where practical science carries board-exam marks yet most students get little real lab time; NEP 2020 pushes exactly this experiential learning.

nodes.label: Indian Virtual-Lab Competitive Landscape
nodes.rationale: OLabs, DIKSHA, LabInApp and PraxiLabs dominate but are static 2D/3D simulations with no live conversational AI tutor; LabSpark's one-line differentiator is 'a science teacher to talk to inside a real 3D experiment'.

nodes.label: PWA App Shell (index.html)
nodes.rationale: Vite entry wiring the manifest, maskable icons, theme-color #0f172a, viewport-fit=cover and service-worker registration (/sw.js) that make the app an installable PWA.

nodes.label: Firebase 404 Page
nodes.rationale: Default Firebase CLI-generated not-found page served by Firebase Hosting.
